# Codex PPT Slide Image Prompt

## Canvas
{
  "type": "16:9 full-slide PowerPoint image",
  "language": "Chinese",

## Deck Goal
面向公司领导与同事，用12页高管汇报解释Data Watch的建设背景、平台架构、四项创新、落地成效和下一步路线。

## Required Background
{
  "deck_context": {
    "source_summary": "Data Watch是面向自动化码头的工业设备数据采集与监控平台。它把S7、GE SRTP、OPC UA、OPC DA等现场数据转换为统一数据流，支持中心式和分布式边缘部署，通过Redis承载实时态、TDengine保存时序历史、MySQL保存配置与权限，并通过Web、桌面App和CLI向业务用户、运维人员、脚本及AI Agent提供受控访问。",
    "core_claim": "先让分散的设备数据完整、持续、可信地流动，才可能实现真正的人机协同与智能运维。",
    "canonical_terms": [
      "Data Watch",
      "Collector",
      "Edge Storage",
      "SQLite outbox",
      "Uploader",
      "Ingest",
      "Redis",
      "Writer",
      "TDengine",
      "MySQL",
      "Backend",
      "Web",
      "App",
      "CLI",
      "AI Agent",
      "Good / Uncertain / Bad"
    ],
    "content_principle": "视觉优先，不把讲稿搬上页面。每页以一个图表、路径、架构、矩阵或核心隐喻承载逻辑，文字只做短标签和结论。不得虚构数据。"
  },
  "slide_local_context": {
    "required_background": "中心式直接进入Redis；分布式先由Edge Storage写SQLite outbox，再由Uploader经Ingest汇入中心Redis。"
  }
}

## Global Style
{
  "name": "麦肯锡风格（样张适配版）",
  "visual_direction": "Premium strategy-consulting editorial slide design inspired by McKinsey/BCG/Bain rational clarity but not an official template. White or very pale cool-gray canvas, sharp Swiss grid, large whitespace, one dominant analytical mechanism, precise hairlines and restrained report metadata.",
  "color_palette": "White, off-white and very pale cool gray; ink blue-gray #243447 for text and structure; restrained steel-blue accent for one destination, key number or causal arrow; near-black for primary titles. No orange, neon, rainbow or large dark blocks.",
  "typography": "Modern highly legible Chinese sans-serif; bold but controlled main title aligned to a slim blue vertical rule; concise labels; compact English metadata; accurate Chinese characters; no long paragraphs.",
  "texture_and_finish": "Clean executive report with faint grid and subtle paper texture, vector-like diagrams, precise spacing and quiet shadows.",
  "deck_consistency": "Match the approved Slide 2 palette, typography mood, density, line weight, target markers and whitespace. Keep one coherent visual identity but vary layout and metaphor by page role.",
  "content_density": "Cover, key-message and conclusion slides are low density. Architecture, comparison and evidence slides are medium density. Never use generic rounded-card grids or text-heavy bullet pages.",
  "universal_avoid": "No real McKinsey logo, client logo, watermark, stock photography, clip art, people icons, robot avatars, decorative gradients, page numbers, invented statistics or unrelated labels."
}

]

## Style Reference Rule
Use Image 1 as the approved sample-slide style reference. Match its palette, typography mood, density, texture, and overall visual identity. Do not copy its exact layout unless this slide's layout explicitly asks for it.

## Input Image Handling Rules
For any input image marked as a strict input asset, include it visibly and preserve its content. Do not redraw, replace, relabel, or invent a similar figure. Scale and crop only as needed for composition while keeping the important labels, arrows, data, and relationships recognizable.

## Universal Constraints
- The final image itself must contain the title and key points.
- Render Chinese text exactly and legibly; avoid garbled characters.
- Keep the confirmed deck style consistent while varying layout by slide role.
- No watermark, unrelated logo, or extra slide number.
